# ADR 0003: Immutable list versions recorded on every decision

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Sanctions screening service

## Context

Auditors ask which list a decision was based on, months later.

## Decision

Each import creates a version (checksum, timestamp); screenings store the versions used; unchanged files create no version.

## Consequences

Full traceability.

## Alternatives considered

Overwriting list tables in place.
